༄༅/ /bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i rim pa zab mo'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i rim pa zab mo'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ bde mchog dbang bskur skabs/ yul grong gtor mas sa bzung ba sogs gang bde skabs thob dang*/ sngon gtor nas bdag bskyed dang*/ bum chog bskyed bzlas grub mtshams/ slob mar sta gon la khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu byas zin nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par mdzad 'tshal/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ sgron gsal las/ de la rab 'bring gi gti mug can la dgongs te bya ba'i rgyud bstan to// gti mug dman pa'i rigs can rnams la spyod pa'i rgyud bstan to// dman pa dang bar ma'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rigs can rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bstan to// 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug rab kyi rigs can rnams la rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud bstan to// rab dang rab kyi 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug rigs can rnams la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bstan te/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag go// zhes gsungs shing gdul bya'i zhing khams dang mos pa dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i don sogs la dgongs nas/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhir bzhugs pa las phyi ma yin zhing*// de la'ang thabs shes kyi rgyud sde gnyis su yod pa las shes rab kyi rgyud dam ma rgyud yin// de la'ang rdo rje gur las/ mkha' 'gro bde dang rgya mtsho bde dang nam mkha' dang*// gser gyi char pa dang ni dga' chen za nus dang*// bde chen sgeg pa dang ni gsang pa yid bde dang*// rgyud sde kun la phan pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang*// gsang ba mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ba// 'khor lo bde mchog gur dang phun sum tshogs pa rnams// rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnams su grags pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i ma rgyud spyi dang*/

snying po dang*/ yang snying gi dbye ba yod pa las 'dir yang snying 'khor lo sdom pa yin te/ mar pa'i mgur las/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa thob// ma rgyud ma hā mā yā thob// snying po kye yi rdo rje thob// yang snying 'khor lo bde mchog thob// ces pa ltar lags/ de'ang bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa mngon brjod 'bum pa zhes bya ba sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pa zhig yod pa las/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di bsdus pa'i rgyud yin te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ tshe thung brtson 'grus zhen pa dang*// srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang*// 'dod la spyod las g.yeng gyur pa// de ltar rgyud rnams nyung ngur gsungs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// de ltar sdom pa'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa de theg pa chen po'i chos rnams mi yul du phebs pa'i skabs su bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams kyang phebs pa yin cing*/ de dag dang lhan cig rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di yang mi yul du phebs/ de nas phyis shig na grub thob sha ba ri pas dpal lū hi pa la gdams/ grub chen de nyid sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bdag por gyur cing rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud spyan drangs/ rdo rje dril bu pas dpal mngon brjod bla ma'i rgyud spyan drangs/ grub chen nag po spyod pas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos tshul rgya chen dar ba mdzad pa ste/ slob dpon de gsum la lū nag dril gsum zhes rgyud 'di'i srol 'byed nyi zla ltar grags pa yin/ gzhan yang bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams nas dngos su bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus mang po grub brnyes kyi slob dpon so sor nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang*/ 'dir slob dpon lū hi pa nas rim par brgyud de dpal nā ro pa'i lugs kyi sdom pa lha lnga 'di ni u pa'i rgyud las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad bstan zin pa'i rjes su slar yang rnal 'byor ma bzhi po bskyar te bstan pa yin la lho brag mar pa lo tsā de nyid 'phags yul du lan bzhi byon pa'i rjes ma'i dus nā ro pa chen po spyod pa la gshegs kyang*/

sngar bla ma nyid kyi bka' gnang yod bzhin du dngos su mjal nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang dang rgyud bshad man ngag zhib rgyas su bstsal/ des sras kyi gtso bo mi la mthu chen la/ des rgyal bas lung bstan chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nu la/ des rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud du gnang ba thugs dam lnga tshan lnga'i nang nas 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba yin la bla med sngags kyi theg pa mtha' dag gi 'jug sgo thun mong ma yin pa ni smin byed kyi rim pa kho na ste/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ba tsam gyis stong pa nyid// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid// dper na pi wang sbyor kun gyi// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra na// ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// zhes dbang ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ thob pa'i phan yon yang*/ dri med 'od las/ skye ba bdun gyi mthar thug par brtson 'grus mi ldan zhing ye shes ma bsgom pas kyang sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// lam 'di 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang smon lam gyi stobs yin no// zhes pa ltar dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing smin par byed pa'i dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gal che bar gdams pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las gsungs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di ni 'jug par byed// de las gzhan pa'i dngos grub 'dod// gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// dad pa mang du byed pa yi// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// tshe 'di 'dod pa gyur pa la// 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'byung*// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes// tshe 'dir 'bras bu rab tu rgyas// zhes bshad pa'i thugs bskyed dang ldan pa'i ngos nas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du man+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

de nas man+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar man+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas thal mo me tog dang bcas pa'i snyim pa sbyar nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum/ de nas sngar gyi lam thun mong ma yin pa 'dir 'jug pa don che bar gdams pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po pa// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan pa bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas su// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje theg pa'i lam du rgyud smin par byed pa la rgyud dag pa gal che bas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i spyan sngar lnga rnam par dag par bya snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bgyid dang de bzhin bgyid bstsal rnams// thams cad rgyal ba rnams kyi mdun du 'chags// gang yang de bzhin gshegs kun sangs rgyas dang*// gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la brten dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang bla ma mchog rnams kyi// dge ba kun la bdag ni rjes yi rangs// dus gsum kun tu gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// nam mkha'i phyogs khyab brtse ldan yon tan tshogs// chos dang skyon spangs 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la// gus pas bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi// sdig pa thams cad rtsad nas zad byed cing*// gang 'dir bsod nams tshogs ni nyer bsags pa// dngos bral gzung 'dzin rnams spangs chos bdag med/

dbyer med byang chub sems ni bdag gis bskyed/ tshangs pa dbang po sogs kyis rnyed dka' ba// dri med rnam dag rnyogs pa yang ma mchis// brtse ldan sras bcas rgyal bas gsungs pa'i lam// rnam dag bsam yas yang dag bsten par bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams khas blangs nas legs par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnam 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan po bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzung par bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyid// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob ma'i snying gar mgrin par dpral bar rnams su/ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ/ brjod bzhin dri yi thig le byas/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po// mgrin par pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru ra āḥdamar po// dpral bar 'khor lor oṃ dkar gyis mtshan par gyur// zhes byin gyis brlabs/ de ltar gdod ma nas rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas man+ḍal la dri bzang gi chus gru bzhir byug nas slob ma'i mdun du bzhag /slob ma rnams la so shing gtad nas/ de nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag par bya ba'i don du khyed rang rnams zhal shar ram byang du lta bas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du so shing bzung nas rtse mo cung zad 'cha' ba'i tshul dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha/ zhes brjod nas dkyil 'khor du 'dor bar zhu/ zhes so shing 'dor bcug la/ de'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bshad pa ni/ rtse mo bdag la bltas na mchog gi dngos grub/ gyen thur mkha' dang sa spyod phyogs bltas na 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyi dngos grub thob bo// srung skud dmar po la/ oṃ khan+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags bdun bzlas bzhin mdud pa gsum re gdab la/ hūm̐ yig las bskyed pa'i srad bu dmar po skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcings pas bgegs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod bzhin skud pa bcings/ baṃ yig las skyes pa'i dung chos kyi chus sdig sgrib mtha' dag bkru ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha d+dharmaḥsarba pa pā ni tsa a s+ye bi shwa dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/

zhes khyor chu lan gsum 'thung du gzhug / de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum+bā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gi sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed pa nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa byas pa gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul 'di gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan cing mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsungs/ hūm̐ dang dhīḥyig las skyes pa'i ku sha'i chun po dag mi gtsang ba sel zhing dge ba'i ltas rtogs par byed pa'i nus ldan du 'gyur// hūm̐/ dang*/ bhīḥ dang*/ khan+ḍa ro he sogs so sor bdun re tsam bzlas/

oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa baṃ/ zhes brjod bzhin che ba stan dang chung ba sngas su gtad/ de ltar gtad pa'i ku sha'i chun po che ba stan dang*/ chung ba sngas su gyis la dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa 'dir nyal nas nangs par rmi lam gang byung ba nga la smros shig /bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ dge ba bsngos nas ci bder bya'o// dngos sta ma sbrel na 'dir 'das ma 'das gtor bsngos dang*/ bdag bskyed bsdu rim sogs rjes chog bya/ phyi nyin bdag mdun bum gsum tshogs bcas grub nas dngos bzhi dbang bskur zhing*/ sbrel na 'dir ras bris bshams nas mdun bskyed 'don/ sta gon gyis lha rnams bsre/ mchod bstod/ gtor bsngos/ phyi rol gtor ma/ nye reg /bdag 'jug /tshogs 'khor bcas grub nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur skabs su/ khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi dbang du byas nas/ 'dir ma rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la/ de yang dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sems can shin tu gdul dka' gang*// sdom pa 'dzin pa mi mdzad cing*// dad dang ldan pa med pa yang*// 'jug pa nyid ni dgag mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar khar sang gi skabs su sngon du 'gro ba sta gon gyi rim pa rnams grub nas/ de ring gi skabs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i bdag bskyed bum bskyed mdun bskyed mchod bstod bzlas pa dang bcas pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang pa rnams legs par sngon du song nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur la/ ye shes theg pa las/ chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag

/bya ba'i rgyud las rab tu grags// rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*// spyod pa'i rgyud las rab tu gsal// phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*// rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar bya// de ni drug gi bye brag dbang*// de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya// rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni dbang*// gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyal bshad// shes rab ye shes bla na med// bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes pa ltar rgyud sde 'og ma dang cha mthun bum dbang steng du bla med rgyud kyi rnam bzhag thun mong ma yin pa mchog dbang gong ma gsum bsnan nas dbang bzhi bskur bas snod rung du bya ba'i thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du man+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ man+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar man+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas sngags kyi skal pa yod med brtag pa'i don du/ bu khyod ci yin dngos po ci la dga'// zhes pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag ni bde ba chen po la'o// de nas skal pa dang ldan par 'dug pas dbang bskur ba'i thog mar sngon chad dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ma mthong ba'i brdar ras yug dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa res gdong g.yogs 'ching bar zhu/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma na ya hūm̐/ slad mar dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten med par mjal du mi gtub pas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du yangs shing snyoms pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ḥ thal mo me tog dang bcas pa'i snyim pa sbyar nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen sogs lan gsum/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba ste lnga rnam par dag pa tshul bzhin du mdzad snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du bstsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag bdag gis bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang*// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sems can mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta ba// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar// de nyid du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang po gzir las grol// zhes lan gsum gyis lnga rnam dag bya/ de nas sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bdag nyid he ru ka gsal snying gar ni// kun rdzob byang sems ngo bo'i zla dkyil dbus// don dam byang sems ngo bo'i rdo rje dkar// rtse lnga 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan par gyur// de ltar gsal btab nas kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pā da ya mi/ lan gsum/ rdo rje snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ su ra te s+t+wām̐ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brtan par bya'o// de ltar sems bskyed pa'i gdams pa blangs nas de'i bslab bya mtha' dag la tshul bzhin du slob snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni// dus ni 'di nas bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob ma'i spyi mgrin snying gar gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod cing dri yi thig le bya/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po// mgrin par pad+ma'i lte bar āḥdamar po// snying gar nyi steng hūm̐ sngon las 'od 'phros// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// byin rlabs bsdus te yi ge so sor thim// de nas sngags kyi gsang ba skal dman la mi bsgrag par gdams pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs kun byin rlabs kyis// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang ba 'di// khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ma zhugs pa rnams la// smra bar mi bya ma dad pa la'ang min// de nas slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje'i rwa sne nas khyed rang rnams kyis bzung ste yol ba'i nang du khrid pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes dkyil 'khor yol ba phye/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo drung du gnas pas lus ngag yid gsum 'dud pa'i brdar thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā/ lan gsum/ shar gyi sgo drung de nyid du gnas te skyabs su 'gro ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bor lha mor bcas pa yi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la ngo chen gyi tshul gyis gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes gsol ba btab pas khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs ste sgo khyams su gnas pa la phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /deng khyod dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// rigs su zhugs kyi ngas khyod la ye shes// gang gi bde gshegs kun gyi dngos grub kyang*// thob na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci// dgos pas de ltar ye shes bskyed par bya'i// khyed kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong mdun nyid du// brjod mi bya ste dam tshig nyams ta re// zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag / de ltar nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'i ched du snying gar rdo rje bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes snying gar rdo rje bzhag / de nas phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'i don du thod pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong dang ming med sbyar bas byin pa'i mos pa mdzod// 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes dam chu sbyin/ yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru// ka nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces// bsgo ba gang yin khyod kyis bya dgos te// nga la brnyas par ma byed gal te na// mi bde ma spang dus byas dmyal ta re// zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag / de rnams dam la bzhag pa bzhi bsgrags su grags pa yin la/ da ni ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba btab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun bdag byin rlobs// he ru ka yi ye shes bdag la phob// lan gsum brjod/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rnams he ru ka mchog yab yum du// gsal ba'i lte bar oṃ las me 'bar bas// snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i o bsregs pas// spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te// lus kun zag med bde chen skyes par gyur// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

dz+nyā na a we sha yā a a a hri baṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a we sha ya hūm̐/ shrī he ru ka ya bisma he bid+ya ra dza ya dhī ma he swā hā/ brjod cing rol mo dkrol/ gu gul la sogs pa'i dud pas bdug / de nas ye shes pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes pas brtan par byas/ khyed rang rnams mig dar gyi 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi thad kyi bar snang du ltos la kha dog ji ltar mthong ba smros shig /de ltar bltas pas kha dog dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po la rgyas pa/ dmar po la dbang*/ nag po la drag po/ kha dog sna tshogs mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub pa yin no// khyed rang rnams la sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngon tshe gang la sbyong ba'i rigs kyi lha skal brtag pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu la dbul ba'i mos pas me tog ltos med du sngags 'dis 'dor bar zhu/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod pas me tog dor/ me tog dbus kyi gtso bo la babs par gyur pas de nyid las lha sku gnyis pa zhig 'phros nas khyed rang gi spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu bzung bar bgyi// zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag / ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang mig dar lhan cig tu bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pā hā ra pa ṭa lam hrīḥ brjod cing gdong g.yogs bsal/ de nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de'ang phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor/ de'i nang du pad+ma'i rwa ba/ de'i nang sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa'i lte bar thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ thog phyur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/

de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar nyi ma dang 'jigs dus kyi gdan la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la g.yon bskor du mkha' 'gro ma/ lā mā/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma rnams dang*/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba'i bum pa'i steng du sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa rang sems bde ba chen po'i snang cha las gzhan ma yin pa mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar yol ba phyi nang du 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams legs par grub nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ dbang bzhi pa rnams su yod pa las rigs pa'i dbang lnga zhu ba'i yon du man+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchog chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas bum pa bcas/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bha wā shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dbang gi rdzas// bum chu dang bcas pad nyir hūm̐ yig las// rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan yongs gyur mi bskyod pa// sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med gyur// mi bskyod yab yum snyoms zhugs zhu gyur pa// bum pa'i chur gyur snying ga'i sa bon gyi// 'od kyis drangs pa'i dbang lha mkhar bzhugs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs rnams dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad// lha mo rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsi yis// gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur khro bo rnams// bgegs bskrad sems dpa' rnams kyis shis mdzad de// bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog

/sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /mchod pa'i lha mos mchod bzhin dbang bskur ro// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rat+na traṃ/ pad+ma hrīḥ karma āḥ bud+dha oṃ/ badz+ro dā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/

bum chu spyi bor blugs/ dbang lha slob ma la thim chu yi dbang*// bskur bas nyon mongs zhe sdang rnam shes kyi// phung po gnas gyur me long ye shes mchog /mngon byas bcom ldan mi bskyod dbu rgyan gyur// de nas rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ cod pan thogs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma cod pan bcas// pad nyi'i steng du āṃ las rin po che// āṃ gis mtshan pa yongs gyur rin 'byung ni// sku mdog ser po rin chen dril bu 'dzin// rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med 'gyur// rin 'byung yab yum snyoms zhugs zhu gyur pas// dbu rgyan du gyur snying ga'i sa bon gyi// 'od kyis drangs pa'i dbang lha mkhar bzhugs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs rnams dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad// lha mo rnams kyis rin chen las grub pa// dbu rgyan bsnams nas dbang bskur khro bo rnams// bgegs bskrad sems dpa' rnams kyis shis mdzad de// bkra shis gang zhig= thams cad= des ni= mchod pa'i= sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen kun gyis mchod byed pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni= oṃ a mu ku ṭā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ cod pan mgor bcings/ badz+ro dā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes chu'i dbang yang bskur/ dbang lha slob ma la thim cod pan dbang*// bskur bas nga rgyal ser sna tshor ba yi// phung po gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes mchog /mngon byas bcom ldan rin 'byung dbu rgyan gyur// de nas 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

rdo rje thogs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rdo rje bcas// pad nyi'i steng du dz+riṃ las pad+ma 'dzin// mtshan pa yongs su gyur las 'od dpag med// sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dril bu 'dzin// rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho gnyis med gyur// 'od dpag yab yum snyoms zhugs zhu gyur pas// rdo rje rab gyur snying ga'i sa bon gyi// 'od kyis drangs pa'i dbang lha mkhar bzhugs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs rnams dbang gi dgongs pa mdzod// lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje 'od 'bar ba// gsor zhing bsnams nas dbang bskur khro bo rnams// bgegs bskrad sems dpa' rnams kyis shis mdzad de// bkra shis gang zhig= thams cad= sems can= des ni= mchod pa'i= sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying gar sogs gnas gsum du reg cing gsor bar bya'o// oṃ badz+ro dā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ dbang lha slob ma la thim rdo rje'i dbang*// bskur bas nyon mongs 'dod chags 'du shes kyi// phung po gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes mchog /mngon byas bcom ldan 'od dpag dbu brgyan gyur// de nas don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dril bu thogs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dril bu bcas// pad nyi'i steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ// mtshan par yongs gyur don yod grub pa ni// sku mdog ljang gu ral gri dril bu 'dzin// rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis med gyur// don grub yab yum snyoms zhugs zhu gyur pas// dril bu'i sgrar gyur snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od kyis drangs pa'i dbang lha mkhar bzhugs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs rnams dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad// lha mo rnams kyis dril bu sgra ldan pa// phyag tu bsnams nas dbang bskur khro bo rnams// bgegs bskrad sems dpa' rnams kyis shis mdzad de// bkra shis gang zhig=

thams cad= sems can= des ni= mchod pa'i= sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas lte ba'i thad du 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ro dā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ chu dbang yang bskur/ dbang lha slob ma la thim dril bu'i dbang*// bskur bas nyon mongs phrag dog 'du byed kyi// phung po gnas 'gyur bya grub ye shes mchog /mngon byas bcom ldan don grub dbu brgyan gyur// de nas rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ rdor dril thogs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma ming gi dbang*// pad nyi'i steng du baṃ las 'khor lo bum// mtshan par yongs gyur rnam par snang mdzad ni// sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin// rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃḥhoḥganyis med gyur// rnam snang yab yum snyoms zhugs zhu gyur pas// mchog gi ming gyur snying ga'i sa bon gyi// 'od kyis drangs pa'i dbang lha mkhar bzhugs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs rnams dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad// lha mo rnams kyis snyan pas dbyangs kyis ming*// 'dogs par mdzad nas dbang bskur khro bo rnams// bgegs bskrad sems dpa' rnams kyis shis mdzad de// bkra shis gang zhig= thams cad= sems can= des ni= mchod pa'i= sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// ming gi dbang mchog chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣi ka ta/

kyai dpal he ru ka zhes bya'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// rdo rje dril bu spyi bor mnyam du bzung la ming gi dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ro dā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes chu dbang yang bskur/ dbang lha slob ma la thim ming gi dbang*// bskur bas nyon mongs gti mug bem gzugs kyi// phung po gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes mchog /mngon byas bcom ldan rnam snang dbu brgyan gyur/ brtul zhugs la gnyis las/ de nas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ rdo rje thogs te/ pad zla'i gdan la slob ma rdo rje sems*// sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// rin po ches brgyan sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dpal he ru ka'i phyag na bsnams// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// dpal he ru ka'i brtul zhugs brten// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dhā ra ya mi hī hi hi hi hūm̐/ rdo rje snying gar bzung ngo*// spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ kha twāṃ thogs la bsangs sbyangs/ slob ma dbang rdzas bcom ldan sku mdog mthing*// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo yongs su 'khyud// dbang rdzas yab yum yongs su gyur pa las// dbang rdzas sa sa so so'i rnam par gyur/ /g.yas su cang te'u/ g.yon du thod pa/ gru khung g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga tshangs skud se ral kha byin la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed dag /dpa' bos byin pa blangs nas ni// dpal he ru ka'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha sku bde ba che// ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid// thod pa de nyid 'dus pa bde ba skyong*// tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa yi don// lung bstan pa ni/ chos gos grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas te lag g.yon pas bzung*/

g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ de nas slob dpon sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par bstan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ltar nga yis lung ston te// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod// rang nyid sangs rgyas sku'i rang bzhin// he ru ka dpal zhes bya yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no// shrī he ru ka te na maḥta thā ga ta s-id+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur+bha bā swā/ dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob dpon sprul sku'i rnam pa can de nyid kyis dbugs dbyung bar mos mdzod/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal zhing*// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du man+ḍal phul/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni deng 'dir bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab ste/ de nas dam tshig gsum sbyin pa las rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ byung rdo rje ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ āḥbyung dril bu badz+ra gan+ḍe āḥ zhes rdo rje dril bu 'dzin du gzhug /sbyor ba kha sbyor gyi dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ slob ma slar yang rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje snyems ma mnyam sbyor gsal bar gyur// rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// de ltar rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i dbang bskur ba thob nas brtan par bya ba'i ched du dbang lha rnams kyis bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/

ji ltar bltams tshe bcom ldan khrus gsol ltar// lha chu dag pas 'dir ni khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ zhes dbang bskur sgo gsum dri ma dag /spyi bor mi bskyod rdo rjes dbu brgyan gyur// khyod kyis 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// 'gro ba kun gyi slob dpon nyid du gyis// dbang lha rnams kyang slob ma nyid la thim// zhes dang*/ de ltar dbang lha rnams dang khyed rang dbyer med du gyur pa la nyer spyod lngas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pu ṣ+pe nas/ ni wid+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ de nas lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// de nyid shes nas de nas ni// gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// 'dod yon lnga la spyod par gyis// zhes dang*/ de nas snying rje chen po'i sgo nas 'gro don byed pa rjes su gnang ba ni/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// lus dang srog la mi lta bar// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos// 'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos// zhes lha mchod pa dang 'gro don gyi rjes gnang byin/ dkyil 'khor lha'i de kho na nyid bshad pa 'di la ma yengs par gsan mdzod/ thar pa chen po'i pho brang rnam snang gi// rang bzhin rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab dur khrod dang*// rdo rwa me ri bcas 'di rang gi sems// dkyil 'khor nyid du snang ba'i yon tan gyi// khyad par rnams las byang chub phyogs kyi chos// so bdun sgo rgyan la sogs snang ba 'di// dkyil 'khor de bzhin nyid du shes par gyis// zhes dang*/ bum pa'i dbang gi phan yon nam rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ ras bris dkyil 'khor nyid las bum dbang thob// lus kyi sgrib bsal bskyed rim bsgom la dbang*// 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur//

gsang dbang ni/ de ltar bum dbang rdzogs par grub nas gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du man+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// sogs/ nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ tsak+shu ban+dha wā ra mā nā ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs 'ching*/ gsang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bcom ldan yab yum snyoms zhugs sbyor mtshams nas// byang sems bdud rtsis sangs rgyas thams cad par// zhu ba'i ngo bo'i bdag byin rlob pa'i tshul// gsang ba mchog gi ngo bos dbang bskur ro// ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyis// deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur ro// bdud rtsi byin/ dam rdzas btung la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a hoḥm ha su khaṃ/ ces brjod du 'jug pas/ bla ma yab yum byang chub sems kyi rdzas// myong bas lus kun bde chen khyab par skyes// gtso bo las spros lhan skyes yab yum ni// bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas rnam gyur nas// mgrin thim rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags// zhes dang*/ nyer spyod lngas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wid+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs sol cig /oṃ badz+ra ne tra a ba ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes gdong g.yogs bsal/ gsang ba'i dbang gi rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong zhing gsang dbang thob// ngag gi dri ma dag nas rtsa dang rlung*// bsgom par dbang zhing longs sku 'grub par gyur// de nas sher dbang la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du man+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ tsak+shu bhan+dha wā ra mā nā ya hūm̐/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtso bo'i yum las spros pa'i rnal 'byor ma// mi yi bu mo gzugs dang lang tsho ni// phul du byung ba phyag g.yon gyis bzung nas// slob ma'i lag pa g.yas su gtad par gyur// dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// slob ma lhan skyes yab yum gsal ba yi// yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las hūm̐// dkar po las ni rdo rje nag po byā// dmar las nor bu'i rtse mo byā ser po// yum gsang mi dmigs ā las pad+ma dmar// 'dab gsum byā las dpa' bo'i byang chub sems// mtshon pa'i ze'u 'brur byā mtshan rang gi lter// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni snying gar/ oṃ sarba bud+dha mgrin par oṃ shrī// dpral bar oṃ hrīḥlha mo'i lte bar ni// oṃ shrī snying gar oṃ hrīḥmagrin par oṃ// badz+ra dpral bar oṃ sarba zhes pa'i// yi ge gsal bar yab yum snyoms zhugs pa'i// byang sems spyi nas mgrin par dga' ba dang*// snying ga'i bar du mchog dga' lte ba'i bar// khyad dga' nor bu'i rtse mor slebs pa na// 'pho med lhan cig skyes dga' myong bar gyur//

de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ sogs/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs sol zhig /oṃ badz+ra nai tra sogs gdong g.yogs bsal/ sher dbang gi rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*// shes rab ye shes dbang thob yid kyi dri// rnam dag rang 'od rig ma bsten la dbang*// 'bras bu chos sku 'grub ba'i skal can gyur// de nas dbang bzhi pa/ de nas dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i don du man+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ tsak+shu sogs/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtso bo las spros lhan skyes yab yum ni// smin mtshams thim pas bde stong ye shes skyes// de ltar bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spros med phyag rgya chen po'i don tshig gis ngo sprad pa 'di la ma yengs par gsan 'tshal// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// de ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ye shes kun ni skye byed phyir// khyod ni pha dang 'dra ba yin// gsum pa'i rgyu las bzhi pa'ang yin// zhes ngo sprad/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs sol cig /oṃ badz+ra ne tra sogs/ dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*// dbang bzhi thob cing sgo gsum dri ma dag /phyag chen bsam mi khyab par bsgom par dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur//

ces brjod/ de ltar dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par bskur zin pas de dag gi skabs su babs pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du man+ḍal 'bul/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos med du 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dbang legs par sgrub pa yin pas 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang*/ rjes chog bkra shis sogs gzhung bzhin bya'o// zhes kun mkhyen dharmā ka ras mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor la tshig sna cung zad bsring nas bltas chog ma bri ba po ni si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
